EXT.evidence: Pushes through a crowd asking to be excused, approaches the gate agent, tries to go onto the jetway to talk to someone, and makes multiple requests openly.

AGR.evidence: Uses polite, cooperative language (asks the crowd to excuse/pardon, greets with “Hi,” and respectfully asks the agent to deliver a message).

CON.evidence: Arrives without a boarding pass and still tries to access the jetway; insists the message is very important but then admits not knowing what to say—showing poor planning and disorganization.

NEU.evidence: Shows urgency and fluster (insists the message is very important yet can’t articulate it, and pressures to bypass rules), indicating anxiety.

OPN.evidence: Attempts unconventional workarounds (asking the agent to relay a message and trying to reach someone on the jetway), showing low caution and improvisation.
